description: This file defines a PHP class 'ADODB2_sapdb' that extends 'ADODB_DataDict' and provides methods for handling SAP DB data types, SQL generation for schema modifications, and type conversions within the ADOdb database abstraction layer.

classes.name: ADODB2_sapdb
classes.description: A class for SAP DB specific data dictionary operations within the ADOdb PHP library.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Converts meta type codes to actual database types, supporting custom types.

methods.name: MetaType
methods.description: Maps generic type descriptions to ADOdb internal type codes, considering field attributes.

methods.name: _createSuffix
methods.description: Generates SQL suffix for column definitions based on attributes like nullability, default, and constraints.

methods.name: AddColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statement to add columns to a table.

methods.name: AlterColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statement to modify existing columns in a table.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statement to drop columns from a table.
